subject: PE
title: PE 9 (Course 1)
description: PE 9 follows the CA High School Course 1 model: fitness assessment and training principles, track and field, badminton and pickleball, rhythms and dance, balance/tumbling/yoga, aquatics and water safety, strength training, and lifetime individual activities like disc golf and jump rope. Students complete the California Physical Fitness Test (FITNESSGRAM) in fall and spring, log activity, and build a personal fitness plan. Aquatics uses a community pool where available, with land-based water-safety alternatives.
framework: California Physical Education Model Content Standards (High School Course 1); 2009 CA Physical Education Framework

standards.PE-HS1-1.1: Combine and apply movement patterns, from simple to complex, in aquatics, rhythms/dance, and individual and dual activities.
standards.PE-HS1-1.2: Demonstrate proficient skills in at least two individual or dual activities (e.g., badminton, pickleball, track and field, disc golf).
standards.PE-HS1-1.3: Perform rhythmic sequences and dances from a variety of cultures, and create and perform original movement sequences.
standards.PE-HS1-1.4: Demonstrate water safety and basic aquatic skills (floating, treading, swim strokes) or land-based water-safety knowledge.
standards.PE-HS1-1.5: Demonstrate balance, tumbling, and body-management skills safely.
standards.PE-HS1-2.1: Apply biomechanical principles (force, leverage, follow-through, center of gravity) to analyze and improve movement skills.
standards.PE-HS1-2.2: Use practice principles and feedback, including video self-analysis, to improve performance.
standards.PE-HS1-2.3: Explain and apply offensive, defensive, and scoring strategies in dual and individual activities.
standards.PE-HS1-3.1: Participate in moderate-to-vigorous physical activity at least four days each week.
standards.PE-HS1-3.2: Assess and meet the Healthy Fitness Zone on the FITNESSGRAM components of the California Physical Fitness Test.
standards.PE-HS1-3.3: Develop, implement, and monitor a personal physical fitness plan.
standards.PE-HS1-4.1: Explain the components of health-related fitness and apply the FITT principle (frequency, intensity, time, type).
standards.PE-HS1-4.2: Calculate target heart rate zones and use heart rate and perceived exertion to monitor intensity.
standards.PE-HS1-4.3: Explain warm-up, cool-down, injury prevention, hydration, and nutrition as they relate to physical activity.
standards.PE-HS1-5.1: Demonstrate responsible personal and social behavior, safety, and sportsmanship in physical activity.
standards.PE-HS1-5.2: Work cooperatively and show leadership in partner and group activities.
standards.PE-HS1-5.3: Set, monitor, and evaluate personal goals; identify sources of self-motivation for lifelong activity.

units.title: Fitness Foundations and Pre-Assessment
units.big_idea: Health-related fitness can be measured, and the FITT principle guides how we improve it.

units.title: Running and Track & Field
units.big_idea: Efficient mechanics and smart pacing make running faster and safer.

units.title: Dual Activities: Badminton and Pickleball
units.big_idea: Racket sports reward consistent technique, shot selection, and good sportsmanship.

units.title: Rhythms and Dance
units.big_idea: Dance builds coordination and fitness while expressing culture and creativity.

units.title: Balance, Tumbling, and Yoga
units.big_idea: Body control, flexibility, and core strength underlie every movement skill.

units.title: Aquatics and Water Safety
units.big_idea: Knowing how to stay safe in and around water is a lifesaving skill.

units.title: Strength Training and Physical Fitness Test
units.big_idea: Safe resistance training builds muscular strength and endurance measured on the FITNESSGRAM.

units.title: Individual Lifetime Activities: Disc Golf and Jump Rope
units.big_idea: Lifetime activities keep us moving long after school ends.

units.title: Personal Fitness Plan
units.big_idea: A personal plan built on assessment data and goals keeps fitness going for life.

weeks.topic: Components of fitness and safe warm-ups
objectives: Identify the five components of health-related fitness

days.title: Fitness components
days.work: Learn the five health-related fitness components, then do a 20-minute circuit with one station for each.

days.title: Dynamic warm-up
days.work: Learn and perform a 10-minute dynamic warm-up (high knees, butt kicks, leg swings, inchworms) and a 15-minute brisk walk/jog.

days.title: Activity log
days.work: Set up a weekly activity log and complete a 30-minute bike ride, hike, or jog at moderate intensity.

days.title: Static stretching
days.work: Learn when to use static stretching; complete a 20-minute circuit and a cool-down stretch routine.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Lead a family member through your warm-up and answer a 10-question fitness components quiz.

weeks.assessment: Warm-up demonstration and fitness components quiz.

weeks.topic: Heart rate and the FITT principle

days.title: Heart rate
days.work: Measure resting heart rate for three mornings; calculate maximum (220 − age) and a 60–85% target zone.

days.title: Intensity test
days.work: Jog, walk, and sprint intervals for 20 minutes, checking heart rate after each and recording RPE.

days.title: FITT
days.work: Design a 30-minute cardio workout labeling frequency, intensity, time, and type, then complete it.

days.title: Interval training
days.work: Complete a 25-minute interval workout (1 min hard, 2 min easy) staying in your target zone.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Quiz on heart rate calculations and FITT; turn in your activity log.

weeks.assessment: Heart rate calculations and FITT workout plan.

days.title: PACER or mile
days.work: Complete the 20-meter PACER (or timed 1-mile run) after a full warm-up and record results.

days.title: Curl-ups
days.work: Learn proper curl-up form and complete the cadence-based curl-up test.

days.title: Push-ups
days.work: Learn 90-degree push-up form and complete the push-up test.

days.title: Active recovery
days.work: Complete a 30-minute easy walk and 15 minutes of mobility work.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Compare results to Healthy Fitness Zone charts and record them in your fitness portfolio.

days.title: Trunk lift and flexibility
days.work: Complete the trunk lift and back-saver sit-and-reach tests.

days.title: Body composition
days.work: Learn what body composition measures and why it's one part of health, then complete a 30-minute workout of choice.

days.title: SMART goals
days.work: Write two SMART fitness goals based on baseline results.

days.title: Goal workout
days.work: Complete a 30-minute workout targeting your weakest component.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Submit a goal sheet with baseline data, goals, and a plan to reach them.

days.title: Running form
days.work: Learn posture, arm swing, and midfoot strike; do 6 form drills (A-skips, B-skips) and a 15-minute run.

days.title: Video analysis
days.work: Film yourself running and compare to a form checklist; note two corrections.

days.title: Pacing
days.work: Run 4 × 400 m (or 2-minute repeats) trying to keep each within 3 seconds.

days.title: Long easy run
days.work: Complete a 25–30 minute continuous easy run or run/walk.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Time trial: 1 mile, recording splits and comparing to your baseline.

weeks.assessment: Mile time trial and form video analysis.

days.title: Sprint drills
days.work: Do wall drills, high knees, and acceleration runs; learn the drive phase.

days.title: Starts
days.work: Practice three-point and standing starts over 20 m.

days.title: Timed sprints
days.work: Time 6 × 40 m sprints with full recovery.

days.title: Video feedback
days.work: Film sprints and use the video to correct arm action.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Sprint test (40 m) and a written explanation of how force and lean help acceleration.

weeks.assessment: 40 m sprint test and written biomechanics explanation.

objectives: Perform standing long jump and softball/frisbee throw technique

days.title: Standing long jump
days.work: Learn arm swing and two-foot takeoff; measure 5 jumps.

days.title: Running long jump
days.work: Practice a short approach and landing on grass or sand.

days.title: Throwing
days.work: Practice overhand throwing with step and follow-through; measure distances.

days.title: Biomechanics
days.work: Experiment with release angles and record which gives the longest throw.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Mini-meet: jump and throw for best marks and record them.

objectives: Apply training principles to improve endurance

days.title: Fartlek
days.work: Complete a 25-minute fartlek run with surges.

days.title: Hill repeats
days.work: Do 6 hill repeats with walk-down recovery.

days.title: Cross-training
days.work: Swim, bike, or hike for 40 minutes at target heart rate.

days.title: Easy run
days.work: Complete a 20-minute recovery run and stretching.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Retake the mile or PACER and compare to week 3 baseline.

objectives: Use correct grip and basic strokes

days.title: Grips and footwork
days.work: Learn forehand and backhand grips and ready position; rally 100 hits with a partner.

days.title: Serves
days.work: Practice short and long serves into targets.

days.title: Clears
days.work: Practice overhead forehand clears, focusing on follow-through.

days.title: Drop shots
days.work: Practice drop shots and net play.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Skills test: serve accuracy and rally count.

days.title: Rules and scoring
days.work: Learn rally scoring and court boundaries; play practice games.

days.title: Singles strategy
days.work: Practice moving opponents with clears and drops.

days.title: Smash
days.work: Learn the smash and when to use it.

days.title: Doubles
days.work: Play doubles with family, practicing side-by-side and front-back formation.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Play a round-robin and self-evaluate sportsmanship.

objectives: Explain the two-bounce rule and kitchen

days.title: Basics
days.work: Learn grip, forehand, backhand, and underhand serve at a public court.

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn the two-bounce rule and the non-volley zone; play practice points.

days.title: Dinking
days.work: Practice dinks and volleys at the kitchen line.

days.title: Strategy
days.work: Learn the third-shot drop and play doubles.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Skills test and quiz on rules.

weeks.assessment: Pickleball skills test and rules quiz.

days.title: Officiating
days.work: Learn to officiate and call lines fairly.

days.title: Tournament day 1
days.work: Play badminton games against family/friends.

days.title: Tournament day 2
days.work: Play pickleball games.

days.title: Teach a skill
days.work: Teach a younger sibling or friend a basic stroke.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write a reflection on strategy and sportsmanship.

days.title: Finding the beat
days.work: Clap and step to songs at different tempos; count 8-count phrases.

days.title: Basic steps
days.work: Learn grapevine, step-touch, pivot turn, and kick-ball-change.

days.title: Line dance
days.work: Learn a line dance such as the "Cupid Shuffle" or "Electric Slide."

days.title: Cardio dance
days.work: Complete a 30-minute dance-fitness video and track heart rate.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform the line dance and self-assess timing.

days.title: Mexican folk dance
days.work: Learn basic zapateado steps from ballet folklórico.

days.title: Hora
days.work: Learn the Israeli hora in a circle with family.

days.title: Korean or Filipino dance
days.work: Learn basic steps of Tinikling (with sticks or tape lines).

days.title: Square dance
days.work: Learn basic square dance calls.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform one cultural dance and explain its origin.

days.title: Choreography elements
days.work: Learn levels, pathways, and dynamics.

days.title: Create
days.work: Create 32 counts of choreography to a song.

days.title: Expand
days.work: Expand to 64 counts, adding a formation change with a partner.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Rehearse and film; adjust timing.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform the choreography for family.

days.title: Dance fitness
days.work: Complete a 30-minute Zumba-style workout and compare heart rate to running.

days.title: Polish
days.work: Polish your choreography.

days.title: Teach
days.work: Teach part of your dance to a family member.

days.title: Dress rehearsal
days.work: Perform a dress rehearsal on video.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Final dance performance and reflection on dance as lifelong fitness.

days.title: Center of gravity
days.work: Experiment with base of support and center of gravity in one-foot and partner balances.

days.title: Static balances
days.work: Hold 10 balances (V-sit, arabesque, tripod) for 10 seconds each.

days.title: Dynamic balance
days.work: Walk a line forward/backward and perform turns on a balance line.

days.title: Partner balances
days.work: Perform safe partner balances with a family member.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform a balance sequence and explain center of gravity.

weeks.topic: Tumbling basics and semester fitness check

days.title: Rolls
days.work: Practice log rolls, forward rolls, and backward shoulder rolls on a mat.

days.title: Cartwheel
days.work: Progress to a cartwheel with spotting.

days.title: Fitness check
days.work: Retake push-up and curl-up tests and compare to baseline.

days.title: Sequence
days.work: Link rolls and balances into a short routine.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform routine and update goal sheet.

days.title: Yoga basics
days.work: Learn 10 foundational poses and breathing.

days.title: Sun salutation
days.work: Learn and repeat Sun Salutation A.

days.title: Flexibility
days.work: Complete a 30-minute flexibility routine and measure sit-and-reach.

days.title: Balance poses
days.work: Practice tree, warrior III, and half-moon poses.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Lead a 15-minute yoga flow for family.

days.title: Core anatomy
days.work: Learn the core muscles and do a 15-minute core circuit.

days.title: Planks
days.work: Practice plank, side plank, and bird-dog progressions.

days.title: Stability
days.work: Combine balance and core in a stability circuit.

days.title: Pilates
days.work: Complete a 30-minute Pilates-style workout.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Plank hold test and curl-up retest.

objectives: Explain water safety rules and drowning signs

days.title: Drowning facts
days.work: Watch an American Red Cross water-safety video and list the silent signs of drowning; then do a 30-minute cardio workout.

days.title: Rip currents
days.work: Learn to spot and escape a rip current (swim parallel to shore) using NOAA diagrams; draw an escape plan for a California beach.

days.title: Reach-throw-don't go
days.work: Practice reaching assists with a pole and throwing a rope or jug to a target 15 feet away, 10 times each.

days.title: Life jackets
days.work: Fit a Coast Guard–approved life jacket correctly and explain how to choose the right size; finish with a 20-minute core circuit.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Water safety quiz and demonstration of a throwing assist.

weeks.assessment: Water safety quiz and throwing-assist demonstration.

days.title: Floating
days.work: At a community pool, practice back and front floats for 30 seconds each and push-off glides. (No pool: practice freestyle arm motion and breathing on a bench.)

days.title: Treading water
days.work: Practice eggbeater and scissor kicks while treading water for 3 × 1 minute.

days.title: Flutter kick
days.work: Kick 8 lengths with a kickboard, keeping legs straight and kicks from the hip.

days.title: Freestyle
days.work: Swim freestyle with bilateral breathing every three strokes for 8 × 25 yards with rest.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Skills check: float 1 minute, tread 2 minutes, and swim 50 yards freestyle.

weeks.assessment: Swim skills check (or land-based technique check).

days.title: Streamline
days.work: Practice streamline push-offs and measure how far you glide.

days.title: Backstroke
days.work: Learn backstroke arm rotation and flutter kick; swim 6 × 25 yards.

days.title: Breaststroke kick
days.work: Learn the whip kick holding the wall, then with a kickboard.

days.title: Breaststroke
days.work: Combine pull, breathe, kick, glide; swim 6 × 25 yards and film one length.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Compare your video to a technique checklist and demonstrate both strokes.

objectives: Use swimming as a fitness activity

days.title: Interval swim
days.work: Complete a 30-minute interval set (e.g., 8 × 50 yards on 1:30) and record heart rate.

days.title: Water aerobics
days.work: Do a 25-minute water-aerobics routine of jogs, jumping jacks, and cross-country skis in chest-deep water.

days.title: Survival skills
days.work: Practice survival floating and the HELP position, and enter the water feet-first safely.

days.title: Endurance swim
days.work: Swim continuously for 15–20 minutes using any strokes.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Final aquatics assessment: 100 yards mixed strokes, 3-minute tread, and water safety questions.

days.title: Muscle groups
days.work: Label major muscle groups and pair each with one bodyweight exercise; complete a 20-minute circuit.

days.title: Squat and hinge
days.work: Learn bodyweight squat, lunge, and hip hinge with mirror feedback; 3 sets of 10 each.

days.title: Push and pull
days.work: Learn push-ups (with modifications) and band rows; 3 sets of 10–12.

days.title: Strength vs. endurance
days.work: Compare low-rep heavy and high-rep light sets and record how each feels.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Technique check on five lifts and a quiz on reps, sets, and safety.

days.title: Design
days.work: Design a 30-minute full-body routine with 6 exercises and correct sets/reps.

days.title: Workout A
days.work: Complete Workout A and log weight/reps.

days.title: Mobility and recovery
days.work: Complete a 25-minute mobility session and learn why rest days matter.

days.title: Workout B
days.work: Complete Workout A again, adding reps or resistance (overload).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Film one set of each exercise and self-correct form.

days.title: PACER practice
days.work: Practice the PACER with a pacing strategy and record laps.

days.title: Upper body
days.work: Practice push-up cadence and complete a push-up improvement circuit.

days.title: Core and flexibility
days.work: Practice curl-ups, trunk lift, and sit-and-reach with flexibility work.

days.title: Targeted workout
days.work: Complete a 35-minute workout aimed at your lowest component.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Full PFT practice run and comparison with fall baseline.

days.title: Aerobic test
days.work: Complete the PACER or mile run.

days.title: Muscular tests
days.work: Complete curl-up and push-up tests.

days.title: Flexibility tests
days.work: Complete trunk lift and sit-and-reach tests.

days.title: Data analysis
days.work: Graph fall vs. spring results for each component.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write a 1-page analysis of progress toward SMART goals.

weeks.assessment: Spring FITNESSGRAM results and progress analysis.

days.title: Basics
days.work: Size the rope and practice basic bounce and alternate step for 10 × 1 minute.

days.title: Tricks
days.work: Learn criss-cross, side swing, and boxer step.

days.title: Intervals
days.work: Complete a 20-minute jump rope interval workout and track heart rate.

days.title: Routine
days.work: Create a 1-minute jump rope routine to music with 5 tricks.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform the routine and a 1-minute speed jump test.

weeks.assessment: Jump rope routine and speed test.

materials: local disc golf course or targets

days.title: Backhand throw
days.work: Learn backhand grip, reach-back, and follow-through; throw 30 discs at a target.

days.title: Forehand throw
days.work: Learn the forehand (sidearm) throw; throw 30 discs.

days.title: Putting
days.work: Practice putting from 10, 15, and 20 feet into a basket or target.

days.title: Flight angles
days.work: Experiment with hyzer and anhyzer release angles and record flight paths.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Skills test: accuracy throws and putting percentage.

weeks.topic: Disc golf rounds and course strategy
objectives: Play a round using strategy and etiquette

days.title: Rules and etiquette
days.work: Learn scoring, order of play, and etiquette; play 9 holes.

days.title: Course management
days.work: Plan shots on each hole and play 9 holes, noting choices.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Practice the shots that cost you the most strokes.

days.title: Full round
days.work: Play 18 holes (or two 9-hole rounds) and walk the course.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Compare scorecards and write about strategy improvements.

materials: equipment for chosen activity (tennis, hiking, cycling, skating)

days.title: Choose
days.work: Choose a lifetime activity (tennis, cycling, hiking, rock climbing gym) and research rules and safety.

days.title: Lesson
days.work: Take a free community lesson or follow a tutorial video and practice for 40 minutes.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Practice the activity for 40 minutes, filming one skill.

days.title: Analyze
days.work: Compare the activity's fitness benefits using heart rate and the FITT principle.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Present a 3-minute talk on the activity and how to start it.

objectives: Use assessment data to design a plan

days.title: Review data
days.work: Review your fall and spring fitness data and identify two priorities.

days.title: Plan design
days.work: Write a 4-week plan with FITT for cardio, strength, and flexibility.

days.title: Barriers
days.work: Identify barriers (time, weather, cost) and strategies to overcome them.

days.title: Start plan
days.work: Complete day 1 of your plan and log it.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Submit the plan for feedback.

days.title: Cardio day
days.work: Complete your planned cardio session and log heart rate.

days.title: Strength day
days.work: Complete your planned strength session.

days.title: Flexibility day
days.work: Complete your planned flexibility/yoga session.

days.title: Choice day
days.work: Complete your lifetime activity session.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Review log and adjust the plan.

weeks.topic: Monitoring, retesting, and adjusting the plan

days.title: Cardio retest
days.work: Retest the mile or PACER after a full warm-up and compare to weeks 3, 8, and 28.

days.title: Overload session
days.work: Complete your strength session with one added set or heavier resistance and log it.

days.title: Motivation
days.work: Read about intrinsic vs. extrinsic motivation and write which strategies (music, partner, tracking app) kept you active this year; then do a 30-minute choice workout.

days.title: Lead a family workout
days.work: Plan and lead a 30-minute workout for your family, including warm-up and cool-down.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write a one-page evaluation of your plan: adherence percentage, results, and two adjustments.

days.title: Favorite activity
days.work: Spend 45 minutes on the activity you enjoyed most this year and record heart rate and RPE.

days.title: Portfolio
days.work: Assemble your portfolio: baseline and spring PFT data, graphs, goal sheets, logs, and best skill videos.

days.title: Reflection
days.work: Write a 1-page reflection on your growth in skill, fitness, and sportsmanship.

days.title: Summer plan
days.work: Write an 8-week summer activity plan with at least 4 active days per week and a backup for hot days.

days.title: Final activity day
days.work: Play a family game day (pickleball, disc golf, or dance) and self-assess sportsmanship one last time.
